observed_statements: To apply for a learner permit, you must be at least 15 years of age.
Required to pass a 50-question closed-book test.
Written knowledge test scores and permits are valid for 18 months.
Page links https://dld.utah.gov/wp-content/uploads/Driver-Handbook-2026.pdf as the Utah Driver Handbook
Never licensed is a closed-book 50-question test.
Previously licensed is an open-book 25-question test.
All questions are based on the Utah Driver Handbook (2026 edition PDF linked).
